# C ABI shared library for whiteout_lib. Every translation unit is
# autogenerated from the C++ headers via `tools/codegen/emit_c.py`.
#
# Compiled `-fno-exceptions` (or `/EHs-c-` on MSVC): the library
# routes its error states through optional/null returns rather than
# throwing, so a C++ exception crossing the C boundary is a programmer
# error worth aborting on.

if(NOT WHITEOUT_BUILD_C_BINDINGS)
    return()
endif()

set(_whiteout_c_sources
    whiteout_c_common.cpp
    whiteout_textures.cpp
    whiteout_mdx.cpp
    whiteout_m2.cpp
    whiteout_m3.cpp
    whiteout_utils.cpp
    whiteout_host.cpp
)
if(WHITEOUT_ENABLE_MPQ)
    list(APPEND _whiteout_c_sources whiteout_mpq.cpp)
endif()

add_library(whiteout_c SHARED ${_whiteout_c_sources})

target_link_libraries(whiteout_c PRIVATE whiteout_lib)
if(WHITEOUT_ENABLE_MPQ)
    # whiteout_mpq exports WHITEOUT_HAS_MPQ=1 PUBLIC so the storage
    # headers' `#error` gate is satisfied for this TU as well.
    target_link_libraries(whiteout_c PRIVATE whiteout_mpq)
endif()
target_include_directories(whiteout_c PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/include
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
)
target_compile_features(whiteout_c PRIVATE cxx_std_20)

# Disable exceptions in this TU only — see header comment.
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(whiteout_c PRIVATE /EHs-c- /D_HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0)
else()
    target_compile_options(whiteout_c PRIVATE -fno-exceptions)
endif()

# On Windows, DLL symbols aren't exported by default. Auto-export
# everything with C linkage so the FFM/cffi side can resolve them
# without us peppering the codegen output with __declspec(dllexport).
set_target_properties(whiteout_c PROPERTIES
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/c-dist"
    WINDOWS_EXPORT_ALL_SYMBOLS ON
)
